notes.note: Dawson was tagged early by Young and also copped a big knee to the ribs in a contest which really impacted him at the time but he played on to have 8 tackles 10 clearances and 27 disposals.  Just watch that rib issue. With the Giants at home this week he may be in line for a rest.
Dawson was one of the best for the Crows with his 35 disposals and goal as he directed traffic in the wet often setting up the play from half back. Watch for a tag from Young this week.
Dawson did have some attention early but the tag was dropped and he racked up 30 touches and a game high 9 clearances. He should go big again this week with Richmond.
Dawson was tagged by Allen this week and had a great first term but then just 10 and 16 points in the last two quarters. He still had a goal and 22 touches with 7 tackles but 54% efficiency.
Dawson was tagged by Jordon but still managed 23 disposals at 56% and had 7 tackles. This was to be expected and no issues for owners.
Dawson just keeps on performing for us with his 29 disposals and 2 goals this week. It is likely to be either Dawson or Rankine that will get the Jordon tag at the SCG this week.
Dawson was intercepting everything and had 27 disposals and 8 tackles He continues to be one of the best in the competition and a must have. Certainly consider him for a C or VC each week.
Dawson was the best for the Crows in the loss. He ended with 25 disposals and 6 tackles showing that even in a loss he can post a big score.
Dawson had Steele running with him and had two goals but just 18 disposals which is down by his standards. This was his first under 100 since round 5.
Dawson was outstanding as he set the win up from the very start. A 68 point first quarter set the foundation with his 3 goals 32 disposals and 7 clearances on the night. A must have.
Dawson was brought in by a lot of teams but some were wary of a tag but he had a big night kicking 3 goals and laying 9 tackles to go with 22 disposals. A great trade in if you need a mid.
Dawson was outstanding in the first term and finished with 9 tackles to go with 28 disposals and 12 contested possessions. He will be a hot target after the bye.
Dawson was the top scorer in the game with his 24 touches goal and 6 marks. He was back in the CBAs with 63% this week which is more than the last two games combined.
Dawson returned this week and put the Crows on his back at stages and ended with 12 marks 29 disposals and a goal. Look for him to hopefully continue with this form.
Dawson returned and was massive. He was taking kick ins as well as kicking 2 goals for his 28 disposals. He didn't spend as much time at CBAs at just 29%. His best score for the year.
Dawson posted his lowest so far this season and he couldn't get the space he wanted in the wet. Nothing to be concerned about here yet.
Dawson returned this week and slotted two goals to go with 23 disposals. He showed no signs of the injury that held him out last week.
Dawson missed this week but had it not been for the short turnaround could have played so hold him. He participated fully at training on Tuesday so it looks like he should be fine.
Dawson had a great second half and really dragged the Crows back into the game and this was reflected in his score. If not for his 64% efficiency he would have had a big score.
Dawson wasn't at his very best but did enough for us with his 21 touches. He did land very heavily on his back in the last minutes of the game but did get up.
